journal.text: Initial $50k portfolio: invest $42k across six relatively resilient uptrends, retaining $8k cash as broad technology/semiconductor shares have fallen sharply into March 31. EXC $46.08 near quarterly highs; ORLY $1,432.58 near highs; MDLZ $67.85 up from ~$60 in late December; TMUS $266.71 versus ~$223 late December; PAYX $154.28 at recent highs; AEP $109.27 near highs. Equal-ish dollar exposure diversifies utilities, consumer staples, telecom, payroll and auto parts. Reconsider individual holdings if sustained breaks of March support emerge (EXC ~$42.5, ORLY ~$1,350, MDLZ ~$63, TMUS ~$250, PAYX ~$143, AEP ~$102); revisit growth equities if sustained price recovery appears. Opening prices unknown; dollar orders prevent gap-related share-size failures.

Hold six defensive relative-strength positions and $8,000 cash. April 1 closes remain near entry and above the March support levels recorded yesterday: EXC 45.92, ORLY 1431.80, MDLZ 67.65, TMUS 268.54, PAYX 154.59, AEP 108.37. One session offers no compelling reason to churn or deploy reserve cash. Reconsider on sustained support breaks (EXC 42.5, ORLY 1350, MDLZ 63, TMUS 250, PAYX 143, AEP 102) or convincing recovery in growth leadership.

Hold six defensive positions and $8,000 reserve. April 2 closes keep EXC 45.97, ORLY 1417.01, MDLZ 66.13, TMUS 264.56, PAYX 154.94 and AEP 107.75 above prior March support despite MDLZ's one-day retreat. Growth bellwether NVDA remains below its March 24 close (110.42 versus 121.41); no reason yet to spend reserve. Reconsider sustained breaks of EXC 42.5, ORLY 1350, MDLZ 63, TMUS 250, PAYX 143, AEP 102, or sustained growth recovery.

Hold six positions and $8,000 cash. April 3's broad growth selloff (NVDA 110.42 to 101.80) contrasted with EXC 47.23, ORLY 1441.89, MDLZ 67.90, TMUS 267.89 and AEP 109.11 advancing; PAYX eased to 153.53. Defensive relative strength remains intact, while volatility argues against spending reserve. Reconsider on sustained breaks of EXC 42.5, ORLY 1350, MDLZ 63, TMUS 250, PAYX 143 or AEP 102, or a sustained broad growth recovery.

Reduce exposure after April 4's second broad selloff. TMUS fell 7.4% to 248.11, breaking the 250 support noted previously; PAYX fell 6.7% to 143.32, just above its 143 support and near its session low. Sell both at the unknown April 7 open; retain EXC, ORLY, MDLZ and AEP, which remain above their March support levels, and hold proceeds as cash rather than buying into falling prices. Reconsider remaining holdings on sustained closes below EXC 42.5, ORLY 1350, MDLZ 63 or AEP 102; redeploy cash only after a sustained stabilization or recovery.

Sell ORLY and AEP after April 7 closes of 1333.84 and 101.57 breached the 1350 and 102 levels previously marked for review; both fell sharply for a second session on elevated volume. Keep EXC (44.69) and MDLZ (65.23), which remain above 42.5 and 63 support, and retain proceeds in cash while price swings are extreme. Reconsider the remaining positions on persistent closes below their supports; redeploy cash after broad prices stabilize for multiple sessions rather than buying a one-day intraday rebound.

Hold EXC and MDLZ, leaving $33,110.77 cash. April 8 saw broad intraday reversals: NVDA opened 103.81 but closed 96.30, MSFT opened 368.26 but closed 354.56; even WMT fell to 81.79. EXC closed 44.49, above the 42.5 review level; MDLZ closed 64.06, above 63 though its decline warrants close monitoring. Avoid adding during the continuing selloff. Reconsider either holding after sustained closes below its respective level, and deploy cash if the broad market stabilizes across multiple sessions.

April 9 broad, high-volume rebound was exceptionally strong: MSFT 354.56→390.49, GOOG 146.58→161.06, NVDA 96.30→114.33. Initiate modest MSFT and GOOG positions ($9,000 combined), retaining about $24,111 cash given the preceding multi-day selloff and risk of another reversal. Keep EXC (44.30) and MDLZ (66.19); both remain above previously identified 42.5/63 review levels. Reconsider new buys if rebound fails on subsequent closes, and defensive holdings on persistent closes below their review levels; add more only if recovery holds across sessions.

Hold EXC, MDLZ, MSFT and GOOG; retain $24,110.77 cash. April 10 did not confirm April 9's broad rebound: MSFT 390.49→381.35, GOOG 161.06→155.37, NVDA 114.33→107.57. Avoid adding into renewed volatility, but one pullback does not yet justify selling the modest new positions. EXC closed 45.12 and MDLZ 65.98, above their 42.5/63 review levels. Reconsider tech exposure if weakness persists or the April lows are retested; deploy reserve cash after several steadier closes; review defensives on persistent closes below their levels.

Add $4,000 WMT after three consecutive rising closes (89.60, 90.61, 92.80), above its late-March/early-April range; keep EXC, MDLZ, MSFT and GOOG. MSFT and GOOG recovered Friday to 388.45 and 159.40, but their sharp April swings argue against adding much tech yet. Preserve roughly $20,111 cash for another setback or a steadier multi-session recovery. Reconsider WMT if it retreats below ~89 on repeated closes; review tech if the April lows are retested, and EXC/MDLZ on persistent closes below 42.5/63.

Add $4,000 ROST and $3,000 TMUS, leaving about $13,111 cash. ROST has risen four closes from 137.00 to 143.66 and surpassed its late-March highs; TMUS has risen four closes from 254.90 to 262.64, approaching its March range. Both provide diversification beyond EXC/MDLZ/WMT and the modest MSFT/GOOG positions. Keep existing holdings: WMT 94.73, EXC 46.86 and MDLZ 68.30 continue recovering; MSFT 387.81 and GOOG 161.47 remain choppy after the April selloff. Reconsider ROST on sustained closes below ~136, TMUS below ~252, WMT below ~89, EXC/MDLZ below ~42.5/63; review tech if April lows are retested. Deploy remaining cash only if recovery broadens and persists.

Hold all seven positions and $13,110.77 cash. April 15 brought pullbacks in ROST (143.66→141.03), MDLZ (68.30→67.03), MSFT (387.81→385.73), GOOG (161.47→158.68) and WMT (94.73→93.97); TMUS rose to 266.71. After deploying $11,000 in the previous two sessions, wait for more evidence before adding. Reconsider ROST on repeated closes below ~136, TMUS below ~252, WMT below ~89, EXC below ~42.5, MDLZ below ~63, or tech if April lows are retested. Deploy cash on a steadier, broader recovery.

Hold seven positions and $13,110.77 cash. April 16 broad weakness: MSFT 385.73→371.61, GOOG 158.68→155.50, WMT 93.97→91.19, TMUS 266.71→259.64, ROST 141.03→138.68; EXC and MDLZ also softened. Tech's recovery remains volatile, while the recent ROST/WMT/TMUS additions have not yet broken their April rebound supports. Avoid adding into two consecutive down days; retain cash for firmer breadth. Reconsider if ROST repeatedly closes under ~136, TMUS under ~252, WMT under ~89, EXC under ~42.5, MDLZ under ~63, or MSFT/GOOG retest April lows (~355/~146). Add selectively after a sustained, broader recovery.

Hold seven positions and $13,110.77 cash. April 17 showed a split recovery: EXC 46.51→47.26, MDLZ 66.48→67.32, WMT 91.19→93.22, ROST 138.68→139.63 and TMUS 259.64→262.04, but MSFT 371.61→367.78 and GOOG 155.50→153.36 continued lower. Defensive holdings remain above their stated support levels; avoid increasing exposure while tech weakness persists and retain cash for confirmation of broader recovery. Reconsider on repeated closes below ROST ~136, TMUS ~252, WMT ~89, EXC ~42.5 or MDLZ ~63; review tech if MSFT/GOOG approach April lows ~355/~146. Add only if recovery broadens and persists.

Trim 14 ROST and 12.5 GOOG shares, retaining the other positions and cash. On April 21 ROST dropped 139.63→135.49, its first close below the ~136 rebound support; GOOG fell for a fifth consecutive session to 149.86, nearing its April closing low of 146.58. MSFT also weakened to 359.12, near 354.56, while TMUS fell to 253.48. Partial trims reduce exposure without assuming one weak session confirms a breakdown. Avoid fresh buys until price breadth improves; reconsider further cuts if ROST remains below 136, GOOG closes below ~146, MSFT below ~355, or TMUS below ~252. Rebuild only after a sustained recovery.

Initiate a $2,500 NFLX position: its April 22 close of 1040.34 cleared the March closing high (~997) after five rising closes, showing relative strength while much of tech remains below its March levels. April 22 also saw all seven existing holdings rebound, with ROST recovering above 136, though one broad up day does not establish a durable recovery. Keep the remaining roughly $14,410 cash reserve and other holdings unchanged. Reconsider NFLX if it closes back below ~990 or its breakout reverses; add to weaker tech only after several days of broader confirmation, and revisit existing support thresholds (~355 MSFT, ~146 GOOG, ~252 TMUS).

Deploy $5,000 of the $14,410 reserve in two small relative-strength positions, retaining about $9,410 cash and existing holdings. IDXX has risen from 406.65 on April 21 to successive closing highs of 421.59 and 426.63; PLTR rose from 90.80 to 93.99 to 100.82, clearing its April 15 close of 98.40. The broader universe also rallied April 22–23, though many April 23 opens faded by the close, so avoid committing the full reserve. Reconsider IDXX if it closes below ~405, PLTR below ~92, NFLX below ~990, or broad gains reverse; increase exposure only if recovery persists. Continue monitoring EXC ~42.5, MDLZ ~63, MSFT ~355, GOOG ~146, WMT ~89, ROST ~136 and TMUS ~252.

Add $2,000 MSFT and $1,500 GOOG as the recovery broadens, leaving approximately $5,910 cash. Through April 24, MSFT closed 359.12→366.82→374.39→387.30 and GOOG 149.86→153.90→157.72→161.47; both have regained their mid-April levels. Keep additions moderate because the recent rebound follows sharp volatility, and MDLZ fell to 65.52. Hold other positions, including the recently initiated IDXX and PLTR, rather than chase their latest gains. Reconsider if MSFT falls below ~367, GOOG below ~153, IDXX below ~405, PLTR below ~92, or the broad recovery reverses; review MDLZ if it breaks ~63.

Exit TMUS: April 25 closed 232.77 versus 262.18 the prior session, breaking our ~252 review level on 13.56m shares, nearly triple April 24 volume. Reallocate only $2,400 to CRWD, which closed 424.88 after 385.75→414.05→424.88 and broke its April 15 high near 400; retain the remaining cash amid sharp overnight and market volatility. Hold other positions: MSFT and GOOG continued recovering, PLTR and NFLX held gains; MDLZ remains above its ~63 review level. Reconsider CRWD on a close below ~390, and reassess broad exposure if MSFT breaks ~367, GOOG ~153, PLTR ~92, or MDLZ ~63. Do not assume today's opening fill or close.

Rotate out of MDLZ: its April 28 close of 65.10 follows 68.29 on April 22 and four weaker sessions, while the account already has substantial defensive EXC and WMT exposure. Fund staged purchases of AVGO ($3,000; 169.58 on April 22 to 192.47 April 28), PANW ($2,500; 163.63 to 181.54), and a smaller, higher-volatility APP position ($1,200; 237.71 to 284.98). Sell first to fund buys; retain roughly $6,100 cash if fills are near prior closes. Hold existing positions. Reconsider the new buys if AVGO closes below ~175, PANW below ~169, APP below ~250, or the broad recovery reverses; reassess EXC if below ~42.5, MSFT below ~367, GOOG below ~153, and PLTR below ~92. Today's fills and closing prices are unknown.

Hold after yesterday's rotation; $6,117 cash provides flexibility ahead of the next monthly deposit. Through April 29, PANW rose to 186.65 and APP to 288.88, while AVGO eased slightly to 191.17; no new-position review level was breached. MSFT (394.04), PLTR (116.08), and NFLX (1125.64) remain firm, while EXC and WMT provide a defensive counterweight. Avoid adding to the recent rally with an already 87%-invested account. Reassess if AVGO closes below ~175, PANW ~169, APP ~250, MSFT ~367, GOOG ~153, or if the broader recovery fails; review cash deployment with the May deposit. Today's opening prices and close are unknown.

Deploy $40,000 of the May deposit into diversified positions, retaining roughly $16,100 cash for volatility. Through April 30, MSFT closed 395.26 after 359.12 April 21; MELI 2330.85 versus 2056.43; AXON 613.30 versus 541.93; TTWO 233.32 versus 205.16. Add META, NVDA, AVGO, AMZN and GOOG in measured amounts to participate in the broader recovery, and VRTX and COST for sector balance. Hold existing positions; APP's sharp intraday drop recovered to 269.31, above our ~250 review level, but do not add. Review risk if MSFT falls below ~367, MELI below ~2100, AXON below ~555, TTWO below ~210, NVDA below ~98, AVGO below ~175, or the overall rebound fails. Today's open and close are unknown.

Hold the $16,121 cash reserve after deploying $40,000 yesterday; the account is about 84% invested. Through May 1 the recovery remains intact (MSFT 425.40, AVGO 197.33, GOOG 162.79, WMT 97.41), but MSFT and META both closed below their sharply higher opening prices (431.11 to 425.40 and 592.08 to 572.21), so avoid chasing or adding immediately. No established review level was breached. Reconsider deploying cash after the gains consolidate; reduce risk if MSFT closes below ~367, AVGO ~175, GOOG ~153, MELI ~2100, or the broader rebound reverses. Today's open and close remain unknown.

Hold the $16,121 cash reserve: the May deposit is largely deployed and Friday's rebound extended, with MSFT closing 435.28, META 597.02, and AVGO 203.64. Avoid chasing after the sharp two-week rise. TTWO gapped down on heavy volume but recovered to close 219.50, above the ~210 review level; monitor rather than sell on one session. MELI slipped to 2280.69, still above ~2100. Reconsider cash deployment after consolidation; reassess holdings if MSFT closes below ~367, AVGO ~175, GOOG ~153, MELI ~2100, or TTWO ~210, or if the broader recovery reverses. Today's opening and closing prices are unknown.

Hold existing positions and $16,121 cash reserve. Through May 5 MSFT 436.17 and GOOG 166.05 held recent gains; TTWO rebounded to 225.32 after Friday's gap, while MELI eased to 2246.54 but remains above the ~2100 review level. Avoid adding after the rapid rebound. Reconsider deploying cash on consolidation or reducing exposure if MSFT closes below ~367, AVGO ~175, GOOG ~153, MELI ~2100, TTWO ~210, or the broader recovery breaks down. Today's open and close are unknown.

Exit VRTX: its May 6 close fell from 500.19 to 450.03 on 8.0m shares versus ~1–2m recently, breaking the April consolidation near 480–500. Preserve proceeds alongside the $16,121 cash reserve rather than adding after the broad rebound. Hold the other positions: TTWO recovered to 231.84, while MSFT 433.31, AVGO 200.09 and GOOG 165.20 remain above their review levels. PLTR's high-volume drop to 108.86 merits monitoring; reassess if it closes below ~100 or if MELI breaks ~2100, TTWO ~210, GOOG ~153, AVGO ~175 or MSFT ~367. Consider redeploying cash after consolidation. Today's open and close are unknown.

Exit GOOG after May 7's fall from 165.20 to 152.80 on 78.7m shares (versus 10.7m May 6), breaching the previously noted ~153 review level and erasing its recent breakout. Retain the remaining diversified holdings; CRWD's high-volume decline to 422.52 warrants monitoring, but its April breakout around 414 remains intact. Keep proceeds and existing cash available rather than immediately buying into this abrupt selloff. Reconsider GOOG after stabilization above ~160; reassess CRWD below ~414 and the broader holdings if the rebound loses support. Today's open and close remain unknown.

Deploy $7,500 of the $25,036 cash reserve into ISRG and SNPS, leaving roughly $17,536 cash. Both have advanced steadily rather than making a single outsized one-day jump: ISRG closed 538.16 on May 8 versus 487.93 April 23, and SNPS 484.50 versus 422.23. Retain existing positions; MSFT 438.17 and AVGO 207.77 remain strong, CRWD rebounded to 428.63 above its ~414 review level, and PLTR recovered to 119.15. Watch EXC after its decline to 45.10; reconsider it if weakness persists below ~45, and reassess new buys if ISRG loses ~515 or SNPS ~459. Today's fills and closing prices are unknown.

Exit CRWD: May 9 closed 410.57, below the previously identified ~414 breakout review level, falling 4.2% on increased volume. Exit EXC: its 45.21 close remains near 45 after declining from 46.90 April 30; the ~$7,904 position is large for a weakening name. Rotate $9,000 into smaller positions in INTU (653.88, rising from 596.05 April 23), CEG (271.37, strong but extended, so size modestly), and MU (85.86, steady advance from 72.93 April 23). Preserve roughly $19k cash after anticipated sells and buys. Reassess INTU below ~625, CEG below ~250, MU below ~79; reconsider CRWD only on recovery above ~425 and EXC above ~47. Today's fills and closing prices are unknown.

Deploy $6,000 of $18,724 cash to add to NVDA and ISRG, retaining ~$12,724 against reversal risk after May 12's broad gap-up. NVDA closed at its $123 session high, up from $116.65 May 9, on 225m shares; ISRG closed $561.43 near its high, continuing its rise from $536.51 May 9 on 2.04m shares. Keep other holdings, including MSFT already ~13% of account; avoid enlarging it. Reassess NVDA if it closes below ~$113 and ISRG below ~$530, or reduce new deployment if the broad rally reverses. Today's opening fills and closing values are unknown.

Hold all positions and $12,723.74 cash today. The growth holdings rallied sharply again May 13 (NVDA 129.93, AVGO 232.42, META 656.03), and yesterday's $6,000 NVDA/ISRG purchase already increased exposure; avoid chasing a second consecutive advance. No existing review level has broken: ISRG 563.95, SNPS 515.71, MU 96.93. WMT slipped to 95.88 from 99.33 May 5, but remains near its April consolidation; watch for a sustained break below ~94. Reconsider deployment on a controlled pullback or sustained consolidation; reassess NVDA below ~113, ISRG below ~530, SNPS below ~485, MU below ~79, and INTU below ~625. Today's open and close remain unknown.

Hold the 21 positions and $12,748.52 cash. May 14 closed broadly firm but much of the growth book is extended after the May 12–14 advance: NVDA 135.34 versus 116.65 May 9, AVGO 232.12 versus 208.20, while MSFT reached 452.94. Avoid adding into this surge; no established downside review level has been breached. COST eased to 991.54 and INTU to 652.83, so monitor rather than enlarge them. Reconsider deploying cash after consolidation or a controlled pullback; reassess NVDA below ~113, ISRG below ~530, SNPS below ~485, INTU below ~625, MU below ~79, and WMT on a sustained break below ~94. Today's opening fills and close are unknown.

Hold the 21 positions and $12,752.58 cash. May 15 brought consolidation after the sharp rally: NVDA closed 134.83, AVGO 232.64 and MSFT 453.13; no need to chase. WMT briefly fell to 91.89 but recovered to close 96.35, above the ~94 sustained-close review level. ISRG 560.28, SNPS 514.48, INTU 661.31 and MU 95.45 remain above prior review levels. Keep cash for a controlled pullback or a firmer base; reassess if NVDA closes below ~113, ISRG ~530, SNPS ~485, INTU ~625, MU ~79, or WMT sustains closes below ~94. Today's opening and close remain unknown.

Deploy $4,000 of $12,752.58 cash into existing smaller positions IDXX and NFLX, retaining roughly $8,753 reserve. As of May 16 IDXX closed 518.10 above its May 12–15 range (~509–513); NFLX closed 1191.53 after rising from 1110 May 12 and clearing its prior ~1188 high. Both have stronger recent price action than several other small holdings, while the larger NVDA/AVGO exposure has already surged. Dollar buys limit spending despite unknown opening prices. Reconsider additions if breakouts fail (IDXX below ~505 or NFLX below ~1140); review NVDA below ~113, ISRG ~530, SNPS ~485, INTU ~625, MU ~79 or sustained WMT closes below ~94. Today's open and close unknown.

Hold 21 positions and $8,752.58 cash after yesterday's $4,000 deployment. May 19 IDXX closed 521.68 and NFLX 1191.64, sustaining the breakouts behind the additions; MSFT 458.87, ROST 154.26 and AXON 742.32 also made recent highs. NVDA 135.57 and AVGO 230.63 remain near their post-rally levels, while META and AMZN are consolidating. Already ~92% invested; avoid adding into an extended book until a firmer base or controlled pullback. Reconsider IDXX if it closes below ~505, NFLX below ~1140, NVDA below ~113, ISRG ~530, SNPS ~485, INTU ~625, MU ~79, or WMT sustains closes below ~94. Today's opening and close unknown.

Hold 21 positions and $8,752.58 cash. May 20 was a mostly quiet consolidation: IDXX 517.16 and NFLX 1192.02 remain above their recent breakout ranges; NVDA 134.38, AVGO 231.68, MSFT 458.17, AXON 742.75 and MU 98.10 retain strong trends. None of the previously identified downside review levels was breached. With ~92% invested after May 19 purchases, keep reserve rather than chase extended prices. Reconsider IDXX on a close below ~505, NFLX below ~1140, NVDA below ~113, ISRG ~530, SNPS ~485, INTU ~625, MU ~79, or sustained WMT closes below ~94; deploy cash on a controlled pullback or fresh base. Today's open and close are unknown.

Sell PANW: May 21 closed 181.26, down 6.8% on 19.0m shares (~2x May 20 volume), breaking its May 5–20 ~187–194 range after an opening gap. Preserve the other positions and cash rather than buy into a broad pullback. IDXX closed 500.87 below the ~505 review level, but this is one session following a steep April–May advance; watch for a sustained break under ~499 before exiting. TTWO 226.76 also weakened on elevated volume; review if it breaks ~225. Reconsider PANW after it regains ~187–190 on sustained closes; review NFLX below ~1140, NVDA below ~113, ISRG ~530, SNPS ~485, INTU ~625, MU ~79 and WMT on sustained closes below ~94. Today's open/close remain unknown.

Sell TTWO: May 21 fell from 237.50 to 226.76 on 6.08m shares; May 22 slipped again to 226.01 on 4.75m, touching 223.12 intraday. Two high-volume declines leave it near the ~225 review threshold and below its May 1 close, so reduce this weaker position. Hold the other positions and cash: IDXX recovered from 500.87 to 504.83, PANW rebounded to 186.14 but has not sustained a return above ~187–190, and most core holdings remain above their review levels. Reconsider TTWO on sustained recovery above ~233–238; review IDXX on a close below ~499, APP below ~350, ISRG below ~530, NFLX below ~1140, SNPS below ~485, MU below ~79 and WMT on sustained closes below ~94. Today's open and close are unknown.

Exit ROST: May 23 gapped down and closed 137.26 from 152.25 on 18.54m shares, versus roughly 2–4m on preceding days, decisively breaking its May uptrend. Start modest CRWD and STX positions: CRWD closed 455.59 above its prior May high near 451 on 4.49m shares; STX closed 112.74 above its prior 109.67 high after two strong, elevated-volume sessions. Keep roughly $10.5k in reserve given pullbacks in several existing holdings and unknown opening prices. Reconsider CRWD below ~430, STX below ~104, IDXX below ~499 on sustained closes, APP below ~350, ISRG below ~530, SNPS below ~485, and MU below ~79. Reassess ROST only after it rebuilds a base. Today's open and close are unknown.

Add $2.5k to CEG: May 27 closed 309.06 above its prior May high (~302.60), following May 23's elevated-volume advance. Initiate a small $2k TSLA position: May 27 closed 362.89 above its mid-May ~350 high on 120m shares, after holding near 333–341 last week. Both are volatile; keep about $6k cash rather than add to CRWD/STX after their rapid two-day advances. Other holdings remain above prior review levels; IDXX recovered to 516.50, APP to 380.91, and SNPS to 511.79. Reconsider CEG on sustained closes below ~290, TSLA below ~333, and existing holdings at prior review levels (CRWD ~430, STX ~104, IDXX ~499, APP ~350, ISRG ~530, SNPS ~485). Today's opening fills and close are unknown.

Exit SNPS: May 28 plunged from 511.79 to 462.43, below the ~485 review level, on 4.81m shares versus typically under 1.3m; do not assume a quick rebound. Rotate $2.2k into APP, which recovered from May 22's 351.47 to 390.26 on May 28, exceeding its previous May high near 380 with two consecutive advances. Retain roughly $7k cash after the trades given APP's volatility and the broad concentration in growth/technology. Review APP on sustained closes below ~350, CEG below ~290, TSLA below ~333, CRWD below ~430 and STX below ~104; reassess SNPS only after it stabilizes and regains ~485–500. Today's opening prices and closing values are unknown.

Hold existing positions and $7,270 cash. May 29 saw broad intraday fades: APP opened 400.10 and closed 384.23, CEG opened 313.88 and closed 303.37, CRWD fell to 458.81 and AXON to 730.29; none has yet broken its prior review level. Avoid chasing the recent breakouts or adding correlated growth exposure after this weak close. STX held 118.14 and MSFT 458.68, so no clear reason to sell. Reassess if APP closes persistently below ~350, CEG ~290, CRWD ~430, STX ~104, IDXX ~499, ISRG ~530 or TSLA ~333; deploy cash if relative-strength leaders stabilize and resume advances. Today's open and close remain unknown.

Deploy $45k of June's new cash across steady relative-strength holdings and four diversifying new positions; retain about $12.3k cash. ADP and BKNG have advanced steadily into May 30, ALNY broke above its May highs on 3.12m shares, and CCEP closed at 91.79 near its monthly highs. Add selectively to existing leaders MSFT, MELI, META, NFLX, WMT, COST, ISRG, AVGO and AXON, most of which recovered or held firm on May 30. Do not add to volatile TSLA, NVDA, or the recent CDNS/SNPS breakdown; PLTR's high-volume rebound warrants observation rather than chasing. Reassess new positions if ALNY falls back below ~285, ADP ~315, BKNG ~5300, or CCEP ~87; existing risk review levels remain APP ~350, CEG ~290, CRWD ~430, STX ~104, IDXX ~499, ISRG ~530 and TSLA ~333. Today's open and close are unknown.

Hold all positions and $12,270 cash after yesterday's $45k deployment. June 2 closes were broadly constructive: MSFT 461.97, META 670.90, AVGO 248.71, WMT 99.77 and ALNY 306.09; none of the prior downside review levels was breached. Avoid adding to the already sizable growth exposure on a single strong session. TSLA remains weak at 342.69 but above the ~333 review level and is only ~1% of account value. Reconsider on sustained breaks below ALNY ~285, ADP ~315, BKNG ~5300, CCEP ~87, APP ~350, CEG ~290, CRWD ~430, IDXX ~499, ISRG ~530 or TSLA ~333; deploy reserve if leadership persists or attractive pullbacks stabilize. Today's opening prices are unknown.

Hold positions and $12,270 cash. June 3 strength in AVGO (256.85), MU (102.25), STX (123.23), IDXX (525.83) and CRWD (488.76) offsets modest weakness elsewhere; no established downside review level was breached. CEG's unusually heavy-volume reversal from a 342 open to a 313.03 close is a warning, but it held near its prior close, so monitor rather than sell on one session. Avoid chasing extended technology holdings after recent June deployment. Reconsider CEG if it loses ~309 then ~290, and reassess ALNY below ~285, BKNG below ~5300, APP below ~350, ISRG below ~530 or TSLA below ~333; deploy cash on sustained leadership or stabilized pullbacks. Today's opening prices are unknown.

Exit CEG and TSLA on breached review levels. CEG followed June 3's 342-to-313 high-volume reversal with a close at 299.54, below the ~309 level, on 4.97m shares. TSLA closed 332.05 below ~333 after retreating from its May 27 high. Keep other holdings: CRWD's heavy-volume gap lower to 460.56 warrants monitoring, but it remains above its ~430 risk level; MSFT, AVGO, STX and ALNY remain constructive. Retain sale proceeds plus existing cash rather than chase extended leaders. Reconsider CRWD on sustained weakness below ~430, CEG if it reclaims ~309, TSLA if it regains ~345 with follow-through; deploy cash selectively on stabilized pullbacks or sustained leadership. Today's open is unknown.

Deploy $7,500 of $19,597 cash into GILD and VRSK, leaving about $12,097 before opening fills.
